usage: Her S2 and S3 consume HP when she doesn't have enough of her Unique Charge {st:ChargeRougeAlly}. HP consumption cannot stagger or kill her and is free once she hits 1 HP.

If she takes damage that would kill her or defends at <10% HP, she gains {st:RougeIshmaelCocoon} and shield equal to her max HP. This gives her 2 turns of survivability where her defense is converted to {skill:10816|05} and she can't use E.G.Os. After the 2 turns, she loses the shield and gets {st:RougeIshmaelEclose} which gives her heal on hit and buffs her skills.

1081601.desc:
On Base Skill Use, at fewer than 10 [ChargeRougeAlly] Count, Clash Power +2

If this unit is in [RougeIshmaelEclose] state, heal 8% HP On Hit using Base Skills (5 times per turn)
1081601.name: Cradle of Change

1081602.desc:
Gain 1 [ChargeRougeAlly] for every 10 cumulative [ChargeRougeAlly] Count this unit consumes in this Encounter

HP consumption effects from this unit's Base Skills do not Stagger or reduce this unit's HP below 1
(At 1 HP, Base Skill effects that consume HP will be activated for free)

In this Encounter, when this unit takes damage that brings its HP down to 0, nullify that damage; then, immediately gain 2 [RougeIshmaelCocoon] and enter the [RougeIshmaelCocoon] state (once per Encounter)
- If this unit entered [RougeIshmaelCocoon] state via its Defense Skill effects, the above effect will not trigger for the rest of the Encounter

When entering [RougeIshmaelCocoon] state, gain Shield equal to this unit's max HP
- Shield gained from this effect does not expire at Turn End
- When [RougeIshmaelCocoon] state expires, Shield gained from the above effect expires

- While in the [RougeIshmaelCocoon] state, aside from its exclusive Skill "As the Voice Says, I Gladly Withdraw into Myself", cannot equip Defense Skills or E.G.O Skills

Turn End: At 0 [RougeIshmaelCocoon] Stack, leave [RougeIshmaelCocoon] state and enter [RougeIshmaelEclose] state; then, gain +5 [ChargeRougeAlly] Count
1081602.name: Into the Changing Room...

1081621.desc:
#1 and #2 Deployed allies heal +20% more HP from Passive, Skill, and Coin effects

On Lust A-Reson., #1 and #2 allies take -10% damage from Skills for the turn
1081621.name: [Actrice Haute Couture du Rouge] - Robes
